samples.title: Lớp học trực tuyến
samples.prompt: You want to learn more about online university classes. You and a friend are beginners. You are both free this weekend, and you want to ask questions and try an activity together. Which of the three options is best, and why?
requirementsVi: Chọn một trong ba phương án.

paragraphs.label: Chọn phương án
paragraphs.text: In this situation, I would choose to attend an online study workshop. I think this option fits my needs best. The important thing is to choose a method I can actually use, rather than simply the one that sounds most impressive.

paragraphs.label: Giải thích lựa chọn
paragraphs.text: The main reason is that we could try a short recorded lesson and discuss it in a small group. We could ask the organiser about anything unclear instead of having to guess. My friend and I could also compare our ideas during the activity, which would make it easier to stay involved. Learning about this topic is worthwhile because students can fit learning around work and family responsibilities.

paragraphs.noteVi: Không nói hai cách kia vô ích; chỉ ra vì sao ít phù hợp trong tình huống này.

paragraphs.label: Giới hạn và kết luận

paragraphs.noteVi: Lớp học cho người lớn cần vừa túi tiền và phù hợp giờ làm, đi lại, chăm con.

paragraphs.label: So sánh hai phương án còn lại
paragraphs.text: I would not choose the guide this time. It could be useful for later revision, but it would not give us immediate feedback when we have questions. Short videos would be convenient too, but watching them separately would not meet our wish to practise together with someone who can help.
paragraphs.noteVi: Không nói hai cách kia vô ích; chỉ ra vì sao ít phù hợp trong tình huống này.

paragraphs.label: Giới hạn và kết luận
paragraphs.text: Of course, I would still check that the information is suitable for a beginner. One point I would want to understand is that people with the greatest need may still be unable to attend. After learning the basics, I could try one small idea and see whether it helps. For these reasons, my first choice would be the most practical starting point.
paragraphs.noteVi: Thừa nhận giới hạn, quay về lựa chọn đã nêu.
